QuestInfo.name: [Theme Dungeon] Twilight Perion
QuestInfo.0:
A viral nightmare has spread amongst the people of Perion, and Athena Pierce is on the case! Help the Maple Alliance uncover the truth behind this nefarious new danger... 

- #eRecommended Level#n: Lv. 190 and up
- #eRoute#n
   1) Accept the quest, 'Second Future' 
   2) Enter the Conference Room of the Maple Alliance from the Dimensional Mirror

- #eFinal Reward#n:
